headline: Democratic midterm wins trigger a global AI and chip sell-off while Indian equities extend a seven-session rally; OpenAI ships GPT-6 Cyber.

stories.title: AP High Court to hear PIL on corruption cases involving CM Naidu on Nov 10
stories.summary: The PIL seeks transfer of cases involving Chandrababu Naidu to the CBI. The counsel argued that complainants are government officials who have not challenged the closure reports.
stories.why_it_matters: A major Andhra Pradesh political and legal development.

stories.title: Telangana: Kaleshwaram barrage restoration to begin in December
stories.summary: The CM directed officials to start restoration works in December, with final approvals due by month-end. Estimated cost is ₹4,193 crore.
stories.why_it_matters: Big Telangana infrastructure and public-finance decision.

stories.title: India flags Chinese-linked AI tools in hacking campaign against financial firms
stories.summary: India's cybersecurity agency named the group behind AI-driven attacks on financial firms and identified its tools, at least two linked to China.

stories.title: AP ZPTC/MPTC local polls pass peacefully amid cyclone rain
stories.summary: Turnout was 82.51% in Visakhapatnam and a provisional 59.98% in ASR district. Kakinada farmers voted late after saving crops from cyclone damage, and boats ferried voters in Konaseema. Polling was peaceful in 44 Naxal-hit areas.
stories.why_it_matters: Grassroots electoral test in Andhra Pradesh.

stories.title: Telangana to launch family insurance scheme on Nov 19
stories.summary: The state government will launch the scheme on November 19. Deepavali celebrations are planned in 2.25 lakh Indiramma houses.
stories.why_it_matters: New welfare scheme in your home state.

stories.title: Bodies of five Tamil Nadu fishermen found near Kothapatnam, AP
stories.summary: Their boat sank 2 km off the shore. The Coast Guard is searching for four others still missing.
stories.why_it_matters: Cyclone-season tragedy on the Andhra coast.

stories.title: AP steps up Ebola surveillance at airports and ports
stories.summary: Medical teams are stationed at three airports and three ports to screen passengers arriving from Ebola-affected countries.

stories.title: SC settles Himachal power dispute: 11,973 MU from Punjab and Haryana over 20 years
stories.summary: The Supreme Court ruled that Punjab and Haryana will supply Himachal Pradesh with 11,973 million units of electricity over 20 years, settling a decades-old dispute.
stories.why_it_matters: A significant inter-state resolution by the Supreme Court.

stories.title: Bombay HC: SIR Form 8 must be decided, deletion without hearing denies vote
stories.summary: The court ordered the Election Commission to restore six names and set aside the rejection of their Form 8 applications.
stories.why_it_matters: Sets a precedent on voter-roll revisions.

stories.title: First India-Sri Lanka ODI moved from Delhi to Visakhapatnam
stories.summary: The match was shifted after a DDCA request, citing potential weather disruption and proposed stadium renovation work.
stories.why_it_matters: An India international comes to Andhra Pradesh.

stories.title: Democrats win House and Senate; AI and data centres a theme
stories.summary: Democrats took control of both chambers in the US midterms. Results are being read as a repudiation of tech industry data-centre plans.
stories.why_it_matters: Shifts US policy on tech, trade and energy.

stories.title: Iran exempts India, China, Qatar, Iraq from Hormuz restrictions
stories.summary: Tehran says ships from four countries can cross Hormuz freely, though analysts say the deals carry political risks.
stories.why_it_matters: Affects India's oil supply and the rupee.

stories.title: White House denies Hegseth and Rubio are leaving after election losses
stories.summary: There are calls to replace Pete Hegseth, who also faces a possible impeachment vote. Rubio is rumoured to be eyeing a presidential run.
stories.why_it_matters: Signals instability in the US cabinet.

stories.title: Israel: Herzog to name candidate to form government on Sunday
stories.summary: A majority of Israeli lawmakers endorsed Eisenkot over Netanyahu.

stories.title: Lebanese brace for possible new Israeli escalation
stories.summary: Lebanese who lived through two Israeli escalations are stocking up and packing bags.

stories.title: Paraguay President Peña resigns after bank collapse
stories.summary: The resignation follows a bank collapse and a lower-house vote to pursue an impeachment trial.
stories.why_it_matters: Major political shock in Latin America.

stories.title: French cost-of-living protests surge as unions join strikes
stories.summary: The interior ministry estimates 600,000 people protested across France; unions say the number was far higher.
stories.why_it_matters: Signals cost-of-living unrest in a major economy.

stories.title: Melania Trump hosts Russian and Ukrainian officials, credited in ceasefire
stories.summary: All sides credited the US first lady with a key but unspecified role in the Ukraine truce.

stories.title: California governor commutes sentences of all 548 death row inmates
stories.summary: California historically had the largest death row population in the US.

stories.title: Sensex, Nifty extend rally to seven sessions, ~9% gain
stories.summary: Indian equities rose on better sentiment after the US midterms, falling crude and renewed foreign buying, outweighing the global tech sell-off. Sensex rose 0.9% and Nifty 0.7% on Friday.
stories.why_it_matters: Key market backdrop for SIP investors.

stories.title: AI and semiconductor sell-off hits global markets after midterms
stories.summary: Asian and Western tech stocks fell sharply as the Democratic sweep fueled fears of curbs on AI.

stories.title: Indian bonds top Asian performers as oil and Treasury yields fall
stories.summary: The benchmark yield fell about 22 bps this week, and foreign inflows hit a high since July.
stories.why_it_matters: Easing yields and oil support rupee and rates outlook.

stories.title: Rupee slips 9 paise to 94.50 vs dollar
stories.summary: The rupee weakened on a firm dollar and higher crude in early trade.
stories.why_it_matters: Currency pressure affects inflation and imports.

stories.title: Micron falls 17% as AI chip selloff deepens
stories.summary: Concerns over AI infrastructure spending and a reported pause in Taiwan facility construction drove the drop.

stories.title: Diwali Muhurat Trading on Nov 8, start of Samvat 2083
stories.summary: The main equity session runs 2:20 pm to 3:30 pm on Sunday.

stories.title: Titan Q2 profit more than doubles to ₹2,393 crore
stories.summary: Revenue grew 23.54% to ₹20,337 crore on studded jewellery demand, and shares rose over 3%.

stories.title: Maxwell Engineering lists at 90% premium; other SME issues debut
stories.summary: Maxwell Engineering, HGS (India), Vectras Enprocon and Johnsoncab Electricals raised about ₹201 crore combined. Maxwell and HGS surged, while Vectras was lackluster.

stories.title: OpenAI launches GPT-6 Cyber, rated 'Critical' for cybersecurity
stories.summary: The model finds and fixes exploitable vulnerabilities and is limited to vetted customers. OpenAI says it went out of bounds less than 1% of the time in testing.
stories.why_it_matters: Major model launch with agentic security use.

stories.title: Anthropic may cut IPO valuation from $1.5T target
stories.summary: The WSJ reports investors balk after the tech sell-off, with one saying valuation could land near $1 trillion.

stories.title: OpenAI's Brockman says IPO-ready in 2027
stories.summary: He said OpenAI is gaining in enterprise markets where Anthropic had already made inroads.

stories.title: OpenAI drops NDAs for data centre projects after midterm backlash
stories.summary: OpenAI committed to not using NDAs with public officials. Meta also warned that political opposition could slow AI expansion.

stories.title: Perplexity launches always-on 'Teammates' agents
stories.summary: The agents take multiple roles in a workspace and pull in projects, skills and memory from Perplexity tools.

stories.title: Claude gets Personal Finance tool via Plaid
stories.summary: Users can connect bank and card accounts and ask about their spending.

stories.title: Cashfree launches 'Checkout for Agents'
stories.summary: The tool lets AI agents process customer payments.

stories.title: Palo Alto in talks to buy AI agent security startup Clutch for ~$500M
stories.summary: Clutch was last valued at $85 million.
stories.why_it_matters: Agent security is a hot area.

stories.title: Claude Code sends your email address to websites, GitHub issue says
stories.summary: The issue drew 968 points and 315 comments on Hacker News.
stories.why_it_matters: Privacy concern in a tool developers use.

stories.title: '*sshole' vulnerability allows SSH access to Linux devices
stories.summary: Certain Alpine configurations are affected; other distros may be too.

stories.title: Google Cloud API Gateway adds streaming support in preview
stories.summary: It targets real-time apps, streaming model responses and multi-step agent workflows.

stories.title: Zero Trust agent systems: moving defenses to the tool layer
stories.summary: Talk covers scoped workload identities, prompt-injection mitigation and kill switches.

stories.title: GCCs ramp up hiring for AI, data, cybersecurity; talent shortage persists
stories.summary: A Quess Corp report says GCCs are directing more tech recruitment to specialists who can deploy AI, manage data and secure systems.
stories.why_it_matters: Signals demand for your target skills.

stories.title: SoftBank credit risk hits 4-year high on AI fears
stories.summary: The cost of insuring SoftBank against default rose to its highest in four years.

stories.title: Moneyview Q2 profit up 5x to ₹201 crore
stories.summary: Revenue rose 41%.

stories.title: Shiprocket posts first profit
stories.summary: It earned ₹60 lakh versus a ₹20.29 crore loss a year earlier.

stories.title: Conway out of ODI series vs India; second ODI in Wellington
stories.summary: Kelly is called in, and rain threatens the match as NZ trail 1-0.

stories.title: Hasan Mahmud takes six as West Indies fold for 356 in Sylhet
stories.summary: West Indies slipped from 264 for 4 on the second afternoon of the second Test.
